title: Nạp file zip có batch plan
plan: hash archive and members, then build a plan bound to the exact ZIP bytes
extract zip to temp dir safely only after plan authorization
plan each file through normal ingest pipeline
apply: run bounded parallel workers with per-file status and a parent journal
never upload zip itself as corpus/NLM source
rules: Each file keeps its own identity

idempotency_contract.idempotency_key: sha256(content-v3: NFC portable_path+sha256+size từng member accepted, sort)+mode+cat_or_profile
idempotency_contract.journal_key: batch item path + child pipeline journal
idempotency_contract.resume_behavior: rerun same zip apply; accepted members are re-planned and child pipelines perform duplicate/readback gates
idempotency_contract.duplicate_guard: zip-slip safe extraction + per-file source hash/path + child ingest duplicate guards
idempotency_contract.readback_command: ingest-zip <file.zip> --cat <NN> --json then inspect each child_result; run live-state-diff after smoke
idempotency_contract.rollback_hint: use per-child journals plus live-state-diff; undo registry per run before any Drive/NLM cleanup
